text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The army is bracing for severe riots in the territories with the start of construction at Har Homa tomorrow.
- King Hussein arrives in Israel today; to visit families of shooting victims.
- Justice Minister Hanegbi to Arafat: No immunity for those who resort to violence.
- Defence Ministry: The early release of Rami Dotan could endanger U.S. aid to Israel.
- February inflation rate rises by 1.2 percent.
- President Weizman's condition satisfactory after hip surgery.
- Army on high alert as construction set to begin at Har Homa.
- Justice Minister Hanegbi: If violence erupts in the territories, Arafat will be ejected from Gaza.
